blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI) remains highly vulnerable to subject motion, particularly in time-efficient protocols and in motion-prone populations. While slice-to-volume registration (SVR) can mitigate inter-slice and inter-stack misalignment, diffusion MRI introduces additional complexity due to diffusion-direction–dependent contrast and the requirement to align dozens of measurements within a common reference frame, effectively yielding a 4D registration problem. Existing approaches rely primarily on sequential modeling or pairwise similarity and often degrade under sparse gradient sampling or severe motion.
We introduce GraphSVR, a q-space–aware graph-based framework for 4D SVR registration in DWI. GraphSVR represents slice groups as nodes in an acquisition-structured graph, with edges encoding temporal proximity, spatial slice geometry and diffusion encoding relationships. A graph neural network predicts globally consistent stack-wise rigid motion, optimized in a self-supervised, zero-shot manner using only an anatomical reference image, without requiring paired ground-truth motion.
We evaluate GraphSVR using both fully synthetic diffusion simulations and realistic recombination-based simulations from real acquisitions with controllable motion severity and gradient sparsity. Performance is quantified using grid error (mm) and rotation error relative to known ground-truth transforms. Under severe motion, GraphSVR reduces grid error and rotation error by 73% compared to FSL eddy, the standard DWI motion-correction method, with the largest gains observed in sparse-direction regimes. These results demonstrate that explicitly modeling acquisition structure through graph-based reasoning improves robustness and global consistency in 4D DWI motion estimation.Code is available at https://github.com/nogakertes/GraphSVR.git .
blocks.zh:
扩散加权成像(DWI)仍然极易受到主体运动的影响,特别是在时间效率协议和运动易感人群中. 虽然片对卷登记(SVR)可以减轻片间和片间错位,但扩散核磁共振由于扩散方向的依赖性对比以及要求在共同参考框架内调整几十个测量结果而增加了复杂性,实际上产生了4D登记问题。 现有方法主要依靠相继的模型或对偶相似性,往往在稀疏的梯度取样或严重运动下降解。
我们引入 GraphSVR, 用于 DWI 的 4D SVR 注册的 q- space- aware 图形框架 。 GraphSVR在获取结构图中作为节点代表切片组,边缘编码时间距离,空间切片几何和扩散编码关系. 一个图神经网络预测全球一致的堆叠式刚性运动,以自我监督,零镜头的方式优化,只使用解剖参考图像,而不需要对地-真实运动.
我们利用完全合成的传播模拟和以现实的重组为基础的模拟来评价GraphSVR,这些模拟来自具有可控运动严重性和梯度性的实际获得。 相对于已知的地面真实变换,使用网格误差(mm)和旋转误差量化性能. 在剧烈运动下,GraphSVR将网格误差和旋转误差比FSL eddy减少73%,这是标准的DWI运动校正方法,在稀疏方向制中观察到的最大增益. 这些结果表明,通过基于图表的推理对获取结构进行明确的建模可以提高4D DWI运动估计的稳健性和全球一致性. 代码见https://github.com/nogakertes/GraphSVR.git。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI) enables in vivo characterization of white-matter microstructure and connectivity [ 14 , 12 , 17 ] . Accurate diffusion modeling requires tens of diffusion-weighted volumes acquired over extended scan times, making DWI highly susceptible to subject motion [ 18 , 10 ] . This limitation is particularly problematic in motion-prone populations, including pediatric and clinical cohorts, where motion degrades image quality, increases exclusion rates, and may require sedation [ 8 , 3 ] . Although echo-planar imaging (EPI) enables rapid slice acquisition, inter-stack misalignment remains unavoidable [ 23 ] . As a result, retrospective slice-to-volume registration (SVR) is commonly used to align 2D slice groups within a consistent 3D reference frame [ 16 , 7 , 26 , 1 , 6 ] .
blocks.zh: 传播加权成像(DWI)使白物质微结构和连通性在体内具有特性[14、12、17]。 准确的传播模型需要通过扩展扫描时间获得的几十个传播加权量,使DWI极易被主题运动[18,10]. 这种限制在运动易感人群中,包括儿科和临床组群中尤其成问题,因为运动会降低图像质量,增加排斥率,可能需要镇静剂[8、3]。 虽然回声-平面成像(EPI)能够快速的切片获取,但内部错配仍然是不可避免的[23]. 因此,通常使用回溯性切片成量登记法(SVR)将2D切片组组合在一个一致的3D参考框架内[16,7,26,1,6].

blocks.en: SVR in DWI is substantially more challenging than in structural MRI. Diffusion-direction–dependent contrast, varying b-values, and acquisition-order effects cause appearance changes across stacks [ 1 ] . Motion must therefore be estimated consistently across multiple diffusion encodings and aligned to a shared anatomical reference, resulting in a 4D registration problem spanning space and q-space. Robustly coupling motion estimates under sparse gradient sampling and severe motion remains an open problem.
blocks.zh: 与结构核磁共振相比,DWI的SVR具有更大的挑战性。 扩散-方向 - 依赖对比,不同的b-值,以及获取-订单效应导致跨堆[1]的外观变化. 因此,必须在多个传播编码中一致估计运动,并与共享解剖参考一致,从而造成跨越空间和q-空间的4D登记问题。 在稀少的梯度取样和严重运动下,强力耦合运动估计仍是一个尚未解决的问题。

blocks.en: Existing methods address this setting only partially. Model-based q-space representations such as 3D-SHORE can synthesize diffusion-weighted contrasts, but their coefficients are estimated independently at each voxel and therefore do not directly enforce spatial consistency of slice-wise motion [ 19 ] . Eddymotion, now continued as NiFreeze, uses leave-one-volume-out signal prediction followed by volume-to-volume registration, and consequently does not explicitly estimate motion occurring between slice groups within a volume [ 20 ] . SVoRT [ 26 ] jointly estimates slice poses and reconstructs a latent 3D volume using a Transformer, but it targets a small number of orthogonal stacks and does not readily extend to DWI acquisitions with many similarly oriented, contrast-varying volumes. In DWI, FSL eddy [ 1 ] is the standard for joint motion and eddy-current correction, leveraging cross-volume information; however, its performance degrades under sparse sampling [ 24 ] and severe motion. Sequential tracking approaches [ 16 ] improve robustness in sparse regimes but do not explicitly model global relationships across stacks and diffusion encodings.
blocks.zh: 现有方法仅部分解决这一设置。 基于模型的q-空间表示法如3D-SHORE可以合成扩散加权对比法,但其系数是每个阴道独立估计的,因此不能直接强制进行切片运动的空间一致性[19]. 现在继续作为NiFreeze的Eddymotion使用留一卷的信号预测,然后进行量对量的登记,因此没有明确地估计在卷[20]内在切片组之间发生的运动. SVORT[26]联合估计用变形器构成并重建了潜在的3D体积,但它针对的是少数正体堆积,并不容易扩展至DWI的收购,拥有许多类似导向,反差的体积. 在DWI中,FSL eddy [1]是联合运动和eddy流修正的标准,利用跨量信息;然而,它的性能在稀疏的采样[24]和严重运动下降解. 序列跟踪方法[16] 改善稀疏制度中的稳健性,但没有明确模拟跨越堆叠和传播编码的全球关系。

blocks.en: We argue that DWI motion estimation is inherently relational: slice groups are coupled through acquisition timing, spatial geometry, and diffusion encoding. This structure is naturally represented as a graph. Graph neural networks (GNNs) aggregate node and edge information via message passing [ 25 ] , enabling globally consistent, permutation-invariant estimation. Similar to pose-graph optimization in multi-view geometry [ 15 ] , DWI stacks can be viewed as multiple encoded views of the same anatomy, suggesting that graph-based reasoning is well suited to 4D SVR. Prior GNN-based registration methods [ 27 ] focus on dense alignment of a few 3D volumes and do not address slice-level, time-ordered, contrast-varying DWI acquisitions.
blocks.zh: 我们认为,DWI运动估计具有内在的关系:切片组通过获取时间、空间几何和扩散编码进行组合。 这种结构自然以图表的形式出现. 图形神经网络(GNNs)通过消息传递的集合节点和边缘信息[25],使得全球一致的,通俗的-变量估计成为可能. 类似于多视图几何[15]中的姿势图优化,DWI堆栈可被视为同一解剖学的多编码视图,暗示基于图表的推理非常适合4D SVR. 之前基于GNN的注册方法[27]注重于几张3D卷的密集对齐,不处理切片级,时间级,反差级的DWI收购.

blocks.en: We therefore introduce GraphSVR , a q-space–aware graph-based framework for 4D slice-to-volume registration in DWI. GraphSVR represents slice groups as nodes in an acquisition graph, with edges encoding temporal proximity, spatial adjacency, diffusion direction, and b-value similarity. A GNN predicts globally consistent stack-wise rigid motion in a self-supervised, zero-shot manner using only an anatomical reference image. This formulation explicitly couples spatial and q-space relationships to enforce global consistency under sparse sampling and severe motion.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们引入了GraphSVR,这是一个基于q-space的基于图表的框架,用于DWI的4D切成卷登记。 GraphSVR在获取图中代表作为节点的切片组,边缘编码时间近近,空间毗连,扩散方向,以及b值相似. 一个GNN只使用解剖学参考图像,以自我监督,零镜头的方式预测全球一致的堆式刚性运动. 这种提法明确结合了空间和q-空间的关系,以便在很少采样和严重运动的情况下加强全球一致性。

blocks.en: We evaluate GraphSVR using recombination-based simulations from measured data and fully synthetic diffusion simulations with controlled motion severity and gradient sparsity. Under severe motion, GraphSVR reduces grid and rotation errors by up to 73% relative to FSL eddy , with the largest gains in sparse-direction regimes. These results demonstrate that modeling acquisition structure through graph-based reasoning substantially improves robustness in 4D DWI motion estimation.
blocks.zh: 我们利用从测量数据进行的基于重组的模拟和具有受控运动严重性和梯度性的全面合成扩散模拟来评价GraphSVR。 在剧烈运动下,GraphSVR相对于FSL Eddy将网格和旋转误差减少高达73%,在稀疏方向制中收益最大. 这些结果表明,通过基于图表的推理对采购结构进行建模,大大提高了4D DWI运动估计的稳健性。

blocks.en: 2 Methods
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overview of GraphSVR. Each slice group (stack) is a graph node; edges encode proximity in time, slice location, and q-space. A GNN predicts stack-wise rigid motion used to warp an anatomical reference into each stack. A multi-scale slice-wise similarity objective plus motion regularization enables subject-specific (zero-shot) optimization.
blocks.zh: 图1:图SVR概览. 每个切片组(stack)是一个图表节点;边缘在时间,切片位置和q-空间中编码接近. 一个GNN预测的是用于将解剖参考器曲折到每个堆栈的堆栈式刚性运动. 一个多尺度的切片相似性目标加上运动规范化可以使特定对象(零镜头)得到优化.

blocks.en: Acquisition and problem setup. A DWI acquisition consists of K K diffusion-weighted measurements with encodings { q i } i = 1 K \{q_{i}\}_{i=1}^{K} ( b i > 0 b_{i}>0 ), together with a small number of non-diffusion ( b = 0 b=0 ) images. With multiband factor p p , each readout produces a slice group (stack) S i S_{i} comprising p p interleaved slices acquired at known spatial locations under encoding q i q_{i} . We represent this acquisition as: 𝒮 = { ( I i , t i , z i , q i ) } i = 1 K , \mathcal{S}=\{(I_{i},t_{i},z_{i},q_{i})\}_{i=1}^{K}, where I i I_{i} denotes the observed image data, t i t_{i} the acquisition time, z i z_{i} the physical slice locations, and q i q_{i} the diffusion encoding. Given an anatomical reference volume A A (T1- or T2-weighted), GraphSVR estimates a rigid transform T i ∈ S ​ E ​ ( 3 ) T_{i}\in SE(3) for each stack. The transforms are obtained by optimizing a self-supervised objective that warps A A into the coordinate frame of each stack and maximizes image similarity.

blocks.zh: 2.2 网络架构

blocks.en: GraphSVR combines convolutional encoders with an attention-based graph network to predict rigid motion. For each stack S i S_{i} , we apply a lightweight 2D ResNet-style CNN [ 11 ] independently to each slice and sum the resulting embeddings to obtain a stack-level descriptor 𝐯 i ∈ ℝ F \mathbf{v}_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{F} .
blocks.zh: GraphSVR将转录编码器和基于注意力的图网结合起来,以预测刚性运动. 对于每个堆栈Si S_{i},我们独立对每个切片应用一个轻量级的2D ResNet风格的CNN [11],并总和所产生的嵌入符以获得堆级描述符 v i → R \ mathbf{v}_{i}\in\ mathbb{R}^{F}.

blocks.en: 3 Experiments
blocks.zh: 3 个实验

blocks.en: 3.1 Data and motion simulation
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据和运动模拟

blocks.en: Quantitative evaluation of SVR in DWI is challenging because real scans lack ground-truth intra-acquisition motion. We therefore evaluate under controlled simulations with known transforms using two complementary strategies: (i) real-image recombination from measured data and (ii) fully synthetic data with controllable motion.
blocks.zh: 对DWI的SVR进行定量评价具有挑战性,因为真正的扫描缺乏地面真实的购置内部运动. 因此,我们利用两种互补战略,在有控制的模拟下对已知的变换进行评估:(一) 从测量数据中进行实景重组;(二) 具有可控运动的全合成数据。

blocks.en: We acquired single-shot EPI DWI data from seven healthy volunteers on a Siemens Prisma 3T scanner at the May-Blum-Dahl MRI Research Center. For real-image simulations, one adult subject underwent five consecutive scans within a single session, changing head pose between scans while remaining still during each scan. Each scan included a T1-weighted anatomical reference (matrix 192 × 256 × 256 192{\times}256{\times}256 , voxel size ∼ \sim 0.9–0.94 mm) and a DWI acquisition with 3 b = 0 b{=}0 and 64 diffusion-weighted volumes at b = 1000 b{=}1000 s/mm 2 (matrix 128 × 128 × 82 128{\times}128{\times}82 , voxel size 1.76 × \times 1.76 × \times 1.6 mm). We estimated inter-scan rigid transforms by registering the T1 volumes using FreeSurfer [ 21 ] . These registration-derived transforms serve as approximate ground truth, as they remain subject to residual volume-to-volume T1 registration error.
blocks.zh: 我们在May-Blum-Dahl核磁共振研究中心用一台Siemens Prisma 3T扫描仪从7名健康志愿者那里获得了单发EPI DWI数据。 就真实图像模拟而言,一个成人题材在一个会话内连续进行了5次扫描,在扫描之间改变头部姿势,而每次扫描期间则保持不变。 每一次扫描包括一个T1加权解剖参考(马特里克斯192×256×256×256×256×256×256×256,voxel大小×××××0.9−0.94毫米)和一个DWI的收购,在b=1000 b×1000 s/mm 2(马特里克斯128×128×82×128 ×××× 1.76×××××1.6毫米)时得到1个DWI. 我们使用FreeSurfer [21] 对T1卷进行了注册,从而估算了扫描间硬化变换. 这些登记产生的变换是大致的地面真理,因为它们仍然受到剩余量对量的T1登记错误的影响。

blocks.en: Real-image recombination: We simulated intra-volume motion by assembling DWI acquisitions from slice groups drawn across different scans of the same subject. Because each scan was internally motion-free but differed in pose, this procedure preserves realistic DWI appearance while providing known stack-wise rigid transforms.
blocks.zh: 真实图像重组 : 我们模拟了量内运动, 将DWI的收购从 不同扫描对象的切片组中收集出来。 由于每次扫描都是内部无运动但姿势不同,这个程序保留了现实的DWI外观,同时提供已知的堆式刚性变换.

blocks.en: Fully synthetic data: Starting from the motion-free first scan, we fit a DTI model [ 4 ] and imposed smooth, time-varying rigid-motion trajectories across slice groups. We reoriented the tensor field using log-Euclidean interpolation [ 2 ] , rotated diffusion encodings accordingly, and synthesized diffusion-weighted images via the DTI forward model. We added Rician noise (SNR=30) and evaluated sparse-direction regimes by subsampling gradient directions using approximately uniform subsets on the unit sphere [ 13 ] .
blocks.zh: 完整合成数据: 从无运动第一次扫描开始,我们安装了DTI模型[4],并强制进行平滑,时间变化的刚性运动轨迹跨越切片组. 我们使用log-Euclideen插值[2]重新调整了拉伸场,相应旋转扩散编码,并通过DTI前置模型合成扩散加权图像. 我们添加了Rician噪声(SNR=30),并通过在单位球体上使用大致统一的子集对梯度方向进行子样本来评价稀疏方向系统[13].

blocks.en: All simulations used multiband factor p = 4 p{=}4 and included two b = 0 b{=}0 volumes. For real-image recombination, we generated acquisitions with 12, 24, and 32 diffusion directions. For synthetic data, we evaluated the same direction counts at three motion-severity levels. In all experiments, the first time point was motion-free and aligned to the reference frame. In total, 21 real-image recombination simulations were generated (3 per subject), and 42 fully synthetic simulations were generated (6 per subject).
blocks.zh: 所有模拟都使用多波段因子p=4 p{=}4,包括两个b=0 b{=}0卷. 对于真实的图像重组,我们产生了12、24和32个传播方向的收购。 对于合成数据,我们评估了相同的方向,在三个运动高度。 在所有实验中,第一个时间点是无运动的,并与参考框架一致. 共产生21个真象重构模拟(每个主体3个),产生42个全合成模拟(每个主体6个).

blocks.en: 3.2 Experimental Setup and Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 3.2 实验设置和评价议定书

blocks.en: We optimized GraphSVR per case in a zero-shot manner with random initialization. We used Adam for up to 400 iterations (batch size 120, initial learning rate 10 − 3 10^{-3} ), together with a ReduceLROnPlateau scheduler (factor 0.5, patience 10) and early stopping after 15 epochs without improvement.
blocks.zh: 我们以零镜头方式优化了每个病例的图形SVR,随机初始化. 我们用亚当来进行多达400次的迭代(批量大小120,初始学习率10 - 3 10 - 10 - 3),加上一个LindleLROnPlateau排程器(系数0.5,耐心10),在15个历程后提前停止,没有改进.

blocks.en: We set similarity weights to α = β = 1 \alpha=\beta=1 , constructed the acquisition graph with k = 4 k=4 nearest neighbors, and used a GNN with two attention layers (four heads, hidden dimension 64). The multi-scale objective employed exponentially decaying pyramid weights λ ℓ = 2 − ( ℓ − 1 ) \lambda_{\ell}=2^{-(\ell-1)} . We selected hyperparameters, including k k and the number of pyramid levels, via empirical tuning on a held-out subset.
blocks.zh: 我们设定了与α = β = 1\ alpha=\β=1的相似度权重,用 k = 4 k = 4 的近邻构造了获取图,并使用了带有两个关注层(四个头,隐藏的尺寸64)的GNN. 使用指数式衰变金字塔重量的多尺度目标 QQ = 2 − (l − 1)\lambda ell QQ2 − (\ell-1)}。 我们选择了超参数, 包括kk和金字塔级的数量, 通过经验调制 在一个搁置子集。

blocks.en: We implemented all experiments in PyTorch and PyTorch Geometric and executed them on a single NVIDIA L40 GPU (46 GB VRAM).
blocks.zh: 我们实施了PyTorch和PyTorch几何的所有实验,并在单NVIDIA L40 GPU(46 GB VRAM)上执行了这些实验.

blocks.en: We compared GraphSVR with FSL eddy [ 1 ] . To reduce confounding from distortion modeling, we used the linear eddy-current field model, disabled susceptibility correction, and re-referenced all eddy motion estimates to the first time point (identity) to align reference frames.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了GraphSVR和FSL Eddy [1]. 为了减少扭曲模型的混淆,我们使用线性eddy-流场模型,减退易感性校正,并将所有eddy运动估计重新引用到第一个时间点(身份),以对齐参考框架.

blocks.en:
In simulation experiments, we evaluated performance using grid error (GE, mm) and rotation error (RE, radians) relative to ground-truth transforms.
Grid error was computed by applying the predicted and ground-truth affine transformations to a regular 3D grid spanning the image domain and averaging the Euclidean distance between corresponding transformed points. GE is reported in millimeters.
For each case and motion condition, we summarized performance by the median error across stacks and assessed significance using a paired two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test across cases.
blocks.zh:
在模拟实验中,我们利用网格误差(GE, mm)和旋转误差(RE, radians)相对于地面真实变换来评价性能.
计算网格错误的方法是,将预测的和地面真实的网格转换应用到跨越图像域的常规3D网格中,并平均在相应的转换点之间的欧几利得距离。 GE以毫米表示。
对于每个案例和运动条件,我们用跨堆叠的中位误来总结性能,并使用对双侧的Wilcoxon签名级测试来评估意义.

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: 4.1 Real-image recombination
blocks.zh: 4.1 真实图像重组

blocks.en: Fig. 2 reports grid error (GE, left) and rotation error (RE, right) for sparse acquisitions with 12, 24, and 32 diffusion directions in the real-image recombination experiment. GraphSVR achieves significantly lower GE than eddy across all sparsity levels.
blocks.zh: 图2报告在真象重组实验中以12,24,32扩散方向进行稀释收购的网格错误(GE,左)和旋转错误(RE,右). GraphSVR在所有Spursity级别上的GE比Eddy要低得多。

blocks.en: Importantly, the recombination protocol introduces abrupt stack-wise pose changes by drawing slice groups from different scans, thereby violating the assumption of smooth, continuous motion. The consistent improvements under this setting indicate that GraphSVR remains robust to non-smooth motion with rapid inter-stack changes.
blocks.zh: 重要的是,重组协议通过从不同的扫描中抽取切片组,引入了突如其来的堆叠式姿势变化,从而违反了平滑连续运动的假设. 这一背景下的不断改进表明,GraphSVR仍然强劲到非平稳运动,并伴随着快速的层间变化。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Real-image recombination: translation and rotation errors. Grid error (GE, mm; left) and rotation error (RE, rad; right) for init , eddy , and GraphSVR across acquisitions with 12, 24, and 32 diffusion directions. Boxplots show per-case median errors across stacks. Asterisks indicate settings where GraphSVR significantly outperforms eddy .
blocks.zh: 图2:真实图像重组:翻译和旋转错误. 网格错误(GE, mm; 左侧)和旋转错误(RE, rad; 右侧)用于内置, eddy, 和 GraphSVR 跨越12, 24, 和 32 扩散方向。 Boxplots 显示跨堆叠的每例中值错误 。 Asterisks 表示 GraphSVR 显著超过 eddy 的设置 。

blocks.en: 4.2 Fully synthetic data
blocks.zh: 4.2 完整的合成数据

blocks.en: Tables 1 and 2 report mean ± \pm std of the per-case median errors as a function of motion severity and number of diffusion directions, respectively. Fig. 3 illustrates a representative moderate-motion trajectory. GraphSVR follows the ground-truth motion more closely than eddy , particularly during rapid pose changes, consistent with improved robustness.
blocks.zh: 表1和表2分别指因运动严重程度和扩散方向数而导致的每例中位差的±\pm std。 图3显示了具有代表性的中度运动轨迹。 GraphSVR比Eddy更贴近地面真实运动,

blocks.en: Table 1 shows that under severe motion, GraphSVR achieves significantly lower errors than eddy . Moreover, GraphSVR maintains comparable error levels across motion severities, indicating stability under varying motion conditions. Notably, grid error remains below 3 mm even in the severe setting.
blocks.zh: 表1显示,在剧烈运动下,GraphSVR的误差大大低于Eddy。 此外,GraphSVR保持了各运动断层的可比误差水平,表明在不同运动条件下的稳定性. 值得注意的是,即使在严重的情况下,网格误差仍然低于3毫米。

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation study
blocks.zh: 4.3 阅读研究

blocks.en: We evaluate the contribution of individual edge features by selectively zeroing components of the joint acquisition space used for kNN graph construction and edge weighting. Experiments are conducted on 4 cases from the fully synthetic dataset (24 diffusion directions + two b = 0 b{=}0 images) under moderate motion. Table 3 reports mean ± \pm std across cases of per-case median-over-stacks grid error (GE) and rotation error (RE). The full edge specification achieves the lowest errors, indicating that temporal, spatial, and q-space information provide complementary constraints. Removing all relational features substantially degrades performance, highlighting the importance of graph-based modeling.
blocks.zh: 我们通过有选择地将用于kNN图构造和边缘加权的联合获取空间的组件零化来评价单个边缘特征的贡献. 在中度运动下,从全合成数据集(24个扩散方向+2 b = 0 b{=}0图像)对4个案例进行了实验。 表3报告是指每例中位数超过网格错误(GE)和旋转错误(RE)的情况。 完全边缘规格实现最小错误,表明时间,空间,和q-空间信息提供了互补的制约. 移除所有关系特征会大大降低性能,凸显基于图表的建模的重要性.

blocks.en: Table 3: Ablation of graph edge components. Each row excludes selected features before edge-weight computation. Values show mean ± \pm std across cases of per-case median-over-stacks errors.
blocks.zh: 表3:图边组件的缩放。 每行在边重计算前排除选定的特性. 值显示为 ±\\pm std ,在每例中位数超过堆错的情况下。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduced GraphSVR , a q-space–aware graph-based framework for slice-to-volume motion estimation in DWI that explicitly models acquisition structure through a weighted graph over time, slice location, and diffusion encodings. By coupling diffusion measurements via graph message passing and optimizing in a self-supervised, zero-shot manner using only an anatomical reference, GraphSVR produces globally consistent stack-wise rigid motion estimates.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了GraphSVR(GraphSVR),这是一个基于q-space的基于图形的框架,用于DWI的切对量运动估计,它通过一个加权图,切片位置,以及扩散编码来明确模拟获取结构。 GraphSVR通过通过图信息传递将扩散测量组合起来,并以只使用解剖参考的自我监督的零镜头方式优化,生成全球一致的堆叠式刚性运动估计.

blocks.en: Across realistic recombination-based simulations and fully synthetic experiments with known ground truth, GraphSVR substantially outperforms FSL eddy , particularly under severe motion, achieving large reductions in both grid and rotation errors. These findings demonstrate that explicitly modeling acquisition relationships through graph-based reasoning enables robust 4D DWI motion correction, especially in motion-prone settings.
blocks.zh: GraphSVR在现实的重组模拟和完全合成实验中,都大大超过FSL eddy,特别是在严重运动下,实现了网格和旋转误差的大幅降低。 这些调查结果表明,通过基于图表的推理来明确模拟获取关系,可以使4D DWI运动发生强力校正,特别是在易运动的环境下.
